frozen_cost_assumptions: BacktestConfig defaults: per side half-spread 2 bps + slippage 3 bps (day) / 5 bps (swing), commission $0.005/share, SEC fee 27.8 per $1M sold, FINRA TAF $0.000166/share sold, short borrow 1 %/yr. Volume policy: IEX intraday volume with point-in-time SIP overlay (16-minute embargo), partial_volume_policy=unverified.
no_tuning: No strategy, planning, cost or volume parameter is changed on the basis of these results. Every run checks the rules hash (research/freeze.py check) and refuses to run if it differs.

historical_validation.universe_rule: research/universe.py: S&P 500 members on T0 (point-in-time file), minus the 9 watchlist companies; median SIP dollar volume over the 126 sessions to T0; close >= $10 on T0; >= 95 % session coverage; one share class per company; take by liquidity rank, at most 7 per GICS sector, until 50. The list is fixed at T0: names are kept after leaving the index and drop out only when their candles end (delisting, acquisition or ticker change).

day.untouched_because: Day-mode development used 2024-11-01 to 2026-04-30 (watchlist only); no day-mode backtest in this research touched any date before 2024-11-01 and none touched these 50 tickers. Disjoint in both time and tickers.

swing.untouched_because: No swing backtest touched these tickers. Not disjoint in calendar time: swing development used the same 2021-07 to 2026-04 calendar on the 9 watchlist tickers, because IEX history starts 2020-07-27 and swing lookbacks need about a year. Disjoint in tickers only; a market-wide regime effect is shared.

historical_validation.primary_endpoint: Net expectancy in R per trade (frozen costs), per mode, with a seeded bootstrap 95 % CI (5,000 resamples, seed 1). Expectation from development: day net about -0.47R, gross about +0.04R (CI includes 0).
secondary_preregistered: H2: higher timeframe aligned = quality component higher_timeframe >= 14 points (the 'aligned' bucket of research/analyze.py by_htf, as in development)
H1 cost scenarios: costs scaled x0, x0.25, x0.5, x1, x2 (x0.2 is roughly the measured NBBO cost)
historical_validation.reporting: By mode, strategy, timeframe, ticker, sector and direction: trades, win rate (Wilson CI), net expectancy (bootstrap CI), profit factor, max drawdown of cumulative R (1R per trade, ordered by exit time), cost sensitivity. Groups under 30 trades are flagged as anecdotal. Multiple comparisons: per-group CIs are descriptive; only the primary and secondary endpoints are confirmatory (Holm across the secondary ones).
protocol_corrections: 2026-10-15, before any validation result was analysed: H2 definition corrected from 'higher_timeframe > 0' to '>= 14 points', the definition used in development (research/analyze.py by_htf).

forward_paper_test.starts: 2026-10-16 (first session after the freeze); never mixed with the historical validation.
forward_paper_test.method: research/forward_test.py replays each completed session with the frozen engine (same replay, entry-eligibility and volume rules as the live scanner; parity-tested) and appends the closed trades to research/validation/forward_ledger.jsonl. Entries are only appended, never rewritten. No orders are sent to any broker, paper or live.
forward_paper_test.note: The 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-15 sealed window is not part of the forward test.

Rule surface = every file under app/strategies, swing, planning, backtest, levels, market, analysis, data, plus app/config.py and the live-path functions Service._window, volume_source, strategy_setups, swing_setups and scanner setup_row, entry_env, live_quote. Its sha256 is identical at the frozen commit a7e60d7 and at 625706c (the last commit before any app change). The engine-configuration and cost/execution hashes are still checked unchanged.
